name: OnlyFlix Local
description: Independent OnlyFlix provider for Nuvio with four current OnlyFlix upstream sources: CDNM, VidAPI, NontonGo and VidFast. Source names are used because webpage server numbers shift by title.

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · CDNM
scrapers.description: CDNM source. Resolves IMDb-backed PlayerJS streams through the dedicated resolver and returns direct HLS qualities up to 1080p when available.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · VidAPI
scrapers.description: VidAPI source through the dedicated OnlyFlix resolver; returns direct HLS.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · NontonGo
scrapers.description: NontonGo/Soap2Day source using the current multisourcesoap endpoint; returns multiple direct HLS candidates.
scrapers.author: OnlyFlix Local

scrapers.name: OnlyFlix · VidFast
